Name: Sound Effect Replacement
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[b][size=4]This mod is longer maintained, please use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14767]Sound Tweaker[/url]﻿ instead.[/size][/b]

This mod lets you create a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ content pack to allow for simple sound replacement.

Content Patcher syntax is as follows (e.g.):


[code]﻿{
    "Format": "1.23.0",
    "Changes": [
        {
            "Action": "EditData",
            "Target": "sound_effect_replacement_dictionary",
            "Entries": {
                "thudStep": "",
                "doorCreak": "dwoop",
                "spring1": "CloudCountry",
                "summer1": "sounds/1.wav"
            }
        }
    ]
}
[/code]
Leaving a value at "" mutes that sound.

Specifying a wav file makes it play that wav file instead.

You can specify multiple replacement options by separating them with a pipe [b]"|"[/b] character, e.g. [b]"dwoop|sounds/1.wav"[/b], etc.

[b]wav[/b] files must specify a path relative to this mod's folder (not your Content Patcher mod), so you must put your wav files in this mod's folder. You can use subfolders as in the above example.

Make sure you specify in your manifest.json file that it is a content pack for content patcher, [i]not[/i] this mod.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires SDV 1.5.5+

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
